# relyt_dps_specs (Data Source)

The DPS specs available in one cloud/region, already filtered by regional availability. The spec list is not the same everywhere — a size copied from another environment's example may not exist here and would only fail at create time.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# The spec list differs per cloud/region and may skip sizes, so look it up
# instead of hardcoding a size that only exists elsewhere.
data "relyt_dps_specs" "hybrid" {
  engine = "hybrid" # hybrid | extreme
  cloud  = "your_cloud_id"
  region = "your_region_id"
  # edition defaults to "standard"
}

resource "relyt_dwsu" "dwsu" {
  cloud  = "your_cloud_id"
  region = "your_region_id"
  domain = "your-subdomain-prefix"
  default_dps = {
    name   = "hdps"
    engine = "hybrid"
    size   = data.relyt_dps_specs.hybrid.specs[0].name
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cloud` (String) The ID of the cloud provider.
- `engine` (String) The type of the DPS cluster. enum: {hybrid, extreme}
- `region` (String) The ID of the region.

### Optional

- `edition` (String) The ID of the edition. Defaults to 'standard'.

### Read-Only

- `specs` (Attributes List) specs available for this engine in this cloud/region (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--specs))

<a id="nestedatt--specs"></a>
### Nested Schema for `specs`

Read-Only:

- `id` (Number) The ID of the spec.
- `name` (String) The name of the spec, used as `size` in relyt_dwsu.default_dps and relyt_dps.
